maria: FYI overnight perf alert — 95th tail latency jumped ~27% on master compared to yesterday's canary. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/perf/latency?range=24h :warning:
perf-bot: [ALERT] job=nightly-latency-suite metric=95p_latency delta=+27% threshold=+10% link=ci.redwood/internal/reports/1912345678
lee: Thanks, looking now. any recent merges to runtime or kernel selector?
tom: landed a small selector heuristic tweak last night (PR 5421) that changes kernel preference when seq_len<128. tagging @lee.
maria: PR 5421 rolled at 02:12 UTC. CI green but nightly shows regression.
chris: grabbing profiling dump from the failing run: ````
perf_summary: total_tokens=1.2M
95p_latency_ms=320 -> 407 (+87ms)
top hot path: kernel_select::choose_best
kernel_switches++ (hot)````
lee: that lines up with the selector changes. can we repro locally with the perf harness?
tom: repro steps: `./scripts/run_perf.sh --model=gpt-8b --seq=64 --concurrency=8 --kernel-trace`
hana: also seeing more KV cache evictions in the same window (eviction rate +12%). could be interaction with batching.
chris: ran bisect across merges between 1912200000..1912340000, culprit points to PR 5421 (tom).
kelsey: if bisect is confident, let's revert the heuristic for the morning rollout. can someone make the revert PR and a hotfix patch?
tom: assembling revert PR now, will include a rollback test and add canary guard. trying to get it up in 30m.
lee: quick idea — the new heuristic favors a smaller kernel for short sequences which increases kernel_switch overhead under our batching pattern. maybe need a threshold based on batch_size distribution, not seq_len alone.
maria: agree. create a ticket to add batch-aware threshold + add a presubmit perf test that simulates our nightly batch distribution.
perf-bot: CI: nightly-perf failed for run 1912345678. See details: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/1912345678/failures
ci-bot: created issue PERF-2042 and attached perf traces.
chris: revert PR opened: https://git.redwood/reverts/5421-revert (draft). will mark for hotfix.
hana: I'll hold the morning release until revert merges. tagging release lead @kelsey.
kelsey: thanks @hana — hold confirmed. once revert is in and a canary run shows metrics back to baseline, we'll continue.
maria: next steps: (1) revert PR -> merge, (2) run 3 canary nightly runs, (3) follow-up PR to implement batch-aware selector. assigning to tom/lee.
tom: ack. will push revert and add tests.
__notes: Generated Slack thread about an overnight perf regression, bisect pointing to a kernel selector heuristic change and KV/batching interactions. Includes bot alerts, profiling snippet, CI links, action items and revert.
